ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; predominantly dark low-intensity pixels with approximately 15% high-intensity (white/grey) mottling concentrated in the distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark substrate baseline. Right lobe distal and medial regions contain irregular, high-contrast light-grey mottling. Left lobe contains sparse, localized white pixel clusters primarily near the trailing edge and lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; approximate internal pixel angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration pattern along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations are most significant on the outer distal edges of both lobes, showing irregular peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Visible convex curvature on the leading edges; trailing edges follow a broad concave trajectory meeting at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with colonization marks are visible on the distal third of the right lobe and scattered near the tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions are detectable on the ventral surface of the right lobe lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between the lobes, with the right lobe exhibiting much higher density of white mottling compared to the predominantly dark left lobe.
